horizon_diagnostic.interpretation: Distant physical queries worsen covalent geometry in both B training seeds, though seed72 is much less extreme than seed71(terminal1ns-grid RMSE1.659A). These are jointly generated windows, not autoregressive accumulation. Per-frame means differ from pooled-window RMSE; this is not a controlled intervention on time features.

cross_seed_interpretation: B seed71 had bondRMSE0.7349,RMSFerror0.9016,MSDerror8.7875 and meanRMSFratio1.5624 at1ns. Seed72 has substantially different motion and less severe geometry damage. Do not select either seed as representative or discard unfavorable runs.

Geometry and torsion-increment degradation versus h/v repeats in both seeds. Seed71 RMSF degradation and unresolved MSD benefit do NOT repeat:seed72 improves both RMSF and MSD errors versus h/v. Preserve these positive motion results despite the geometry failure.

B remains worse than released BioKinema on geometry/MSD/torsion-increment errors in both seeds; RMSF difference is unresolved in seed72. BioKinema native H1+MSA and known46/48 training overlap prevent an equal-input or sequence-independent claim.

A seed72 native1ns is not complete; no two-seed A/B1ns ranking yet. Both B seeds used identical recipe/exposure within their paired A/B runs, but only two seeds cannot quantify broad optimization robustness.
No change to source noise, clocks, solver, clipping, data membership or checkpoints. No static pretraining in these MD-only results; not a causal verdict against EDM or coordinate-state generation.
